title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Solutions Towards a Better Future programme will work in Centre Department and Port-au-Prince City, Haiti. It aims to contribute to Concern Haiti’s Durable Solutions thematic programme, and the goal of the grant is to increase the socio-economic resilience and self-reliance of the most vulnerable displacement-affected households through improved access to diversified livelihoods and improved social capital. The programme will support over 18,500 people living in Extreme poor households, female headed households, households with disabled members, youth, IDPs. This will be done through improved access to business knowledge and skills, adoption of climate-smart agricultural practices among displaced and host communities, strengthened and more inclusive urban rural trade linkages for increased returns on livelihoods assets and effort and increased programme and community knowledge of root causes of conflict and links to displacement.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Improved wellbeing of vulnerable programme participants with a specific focus on women and children at risk or exposed to violence. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Capacity Building 1: This outcome includes training of CSO on the various Social Accountability tools, such as awareness campaigns, complaints mechanisms, and public hearings to organize collective action that improves public sector responsiveness and leads to better outcomes. Gender Equality 1: the programme design applies a gender transformative approach to promoting gender equality, which ensures that gender and inclusion perspectives are central to all the programme stages and that it tackles some of the root causes of gender inequality, including harmful attitudes and practices.
